Question 3
?

Consider the finite region bounded by the curves x=4−y2, x=−12y+1, and the x-axis, as shown above. Find an integral expression for the volume of the solid generated when this region is rotated 2π radians about the x-axis.

a
 2π∫01y(4−y2−12y+1)dy
b
 2π∫02y(1−12y−4−y2)dy
c
 2π∫01y(2−y−4−y2)dy
d
 2π∫02y(4−y2+12y−1)dy
e
 2π∫02y(4−y2+y−2)dy
Submit
